messages:
alex: Quick async — where are we on console observability for the upcoming milestone? Need status on: tracing hooks for inference routes, dashboard owners for error-analysis/latency views, the proposed trace retention bump to 90d, and any CRs blocking merges. Can owners please ping status + ETA? cc @maya @cj @ranjit

maya: Tracing hooks PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/472. Adds sampling + span attrs for model, seq_len, and client_id (hashed). I can run a smoke test on staging today.

cj: Retention change requires security review — traces may contain sensitive metadata. I opened SEC-231 to capture redaction/retention concerns. Waiting on review, ETA Thu EOD unless security requests changes.

ranjit: I can own dashboards. Will port panels to the new trace index and add error-grouping + p95 latency panels. Need a sample span name and a couple of example queries for grouping. @maya can you paste a sample span or minimal event shape?

maya: span name is inference.generate.v1; tags: model, seq_len, client_id (hashed), sample_rate. Example query snippets:
```
# error grouping by exception type
errors: filter(events, event.type=="span" and span.status=="error") | group_by(span.tags.exception) | count()

# p95 latency for inference by model
latency: filter(events, event.type=="span" and span.name=="inference.generate.v1") | percentiles(span.duration_ms, [95]) by span.tags.model
```
Use hashed client_id for any join with user metadata.

cj: FYI Finance flagged the retention bump — estimated +~20% storage cost on prod based on current volume. I'll get a short delta report into SEC-231 for approval.

alex: Owners summary: tracing validation -> maya; dashboards -> ranjit; retention sign-off -> cj/security. CR blockers?

maya: One CR is waiting for eng-runtime review (small API change to hook registration). @alex can you take a look? It's a 6-line change.

alex: Will review by 2pm PST today. If anyone needs faster, leave an inline comment and I'll prioritize.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for branch feature/obs-hooks at 2065432120 — all tests green. :white_check_mark:

maya: Smoke tests on staging passed, found one mismatch: legacy clients send client_id unhashed in metadata. Pushing a tiny fix to normalize before span emit.

ranjit: Starting dashboards now, will open a PR with panels + queries and screenshots. ETA tomorrow 12:00pm PT.

cj: Security asked for a one-pager on what metadata is collected and retention rules. I'll attach SEC-231 notes when ready; will aim to have the doc for review by tomorrow morning.

alex: Thanks all. If things remain async, please post a short update here by EOD so I can close the milestone checklist. If any open items after that, we can do a 15-min sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
